No drift term is defensible - the stock has been range-bound 2.79-3.13 for three weeks after the Aug 20-21 +38% spike, H1 results are already published (Aug 20), and no company event is scheduled inside the window. calls.reconciliation: Disputes were: (a) the anchor close - settled at HK$2.975 for 8 Sep, triply sourced, superseding the Background's stale 3.13; (b) H1 loss magnitude (HK$1.26bn vs HK$790-800m) - could NOT be settled without web access this run, but it is immaterial since the release predates the window and the price already repriced on it; (c) a 16 Sep ex-rights date - settled negative, Run 3 traced it to Yuk Wing Group (01536) and the other two independently found no Boyaa corporate action, so the raw Close carries no adjustment; (d) the 15-16 Sep FOMC, raised by one run only, unchallenged and consistent with the standing calendar - treated as a vol-widener reaching HK on 17 Sep, not a drift term; (e) volatility regime, pure judgment. On (e) the runs' DECLARED widths (1.24/1.15/1.05) contradict their own percentiles, whose realized 90-10 widths are 1.26/1.18/1.16 (implied sigma 0.16/0.152/0.151) - Run 3's 1.05 is an arithmetic slip, not a genuinely tighter view, so I did not treat it as a dissent. I take sigma_8 = 0.16, at the top of that implied band, because the jump rate (~5 of 40 sessions with |move| >= 9.5%, i.e. ~1 expected jump in 8 sessions) plus FOMC argue against the quiet-regime number. Run 2's empirical 8-session median ratio of 1.043 was correctly discarded by its own author as BTC-rally contamination; I keep the median driftless at spot. Escapes: -39.5% to reach 1.80 needs a BTC capitulation or a dilutive placement (largest observed 8-session drawdown in sample was ~-8%), priced 1.2%; +102% to reach 6.00 exceeds the largest observed 8-session move (+38%, itself an earnings reset) and needs a BTC melt-up plus multiple expansion, priced 0.8% - slightly below Runs 1/2, since the +38% precedent was a scheduled-catalyst move and no catalyst is scheduled here.
